label: Half Lining
description: A half-lined jacket retains lining on the front panels and the upper half of the back but leaves the lower back unlined, exposing the reverse of the fabric or a neat turned-and-stitched seam finish. This construction substantially reduces the jacket's weight and improves ventilation across the back — where body heat accumulates most — without sacrificing the easy-donning comfort of lined front panels. It is the preferred choice for medium-weight spring and autumn suits and for bespoke clients who want a single jacket to serve across a broad range of temperatures.
